title: Hashima HP-900LFS
subtitle: Straight Linear Fusing Press

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Hashima HP-900LFS is a continuous-type straight linear fusing press used in garment production to bond interlining to shirt collars, cuffs, plackets, waistbands, and other garment components. It uses a moving belt system to feed assembled garment parts through a heated fusing zone, producing consistent interlining adhesion at industrial throughput.
applications: Fusing interlining onto shirt collars, cuffs, and front plackets
Fusing waistbands and panel reinforcements on trousers / jeans
Continuous bonding of large garment components (full front panels)
Production-line interlining in medium to large garment factories
purposeAndApplication.industry: Shirt manufacturing, garment production, trouser / jeans production, workwear and uniform manufacturing

overviewDescription: The Hashima HP-900LFS is a continuous-type linear fusing press. It runs on 3-phase 380V power with a 12 kW heater and 295 W motor, and supports fusing widths up to 900 mm. The belt speed reaches a maximum of 10.2 m/min, the maximum pressure is 41 N/cm² (4.02 kg/cm²), and the maximum temperature is 195 °C, with heating times selectable from 6 to 28 seconds. The unit features automatic belt-warping prevention, an electronic thermostat + SSR control (±3 °C accuracy), a standard Strip-Off Device, a big-diameter pressure roller, a puckering-prevention roller, and a seamless belt. Net weight is 450 kg; dimensions are 1,200 × 1,490 × 3,300 mm.

finalNotes:
• The 'LFS' suffix indicates the Linear / Fusing / Strip-Off-Standard configuration — a continuous-type industrial fusing press with the strip-off device included as standard.
• Hashima is one of two dominant fusing-press brands (along with Macon) in industrial garment production worldwide.
• Phase 1 verification: Tier-1 Hashima HP-600LF/HP-900LF product page confirms 12 kW heater, 295 W motor, 900 mm width, 10.2 m/min belt speed, 41 N/cm² max pressure for the HP-900LF/LFS family. Tier-2 distributor pages independently confirm 3P380V, 450 kg weight, 3300×1490×1200 mm dimensions.
• Phase 1 complete with PASS verdict. Detailed Research (working principles, sequence flow, parts list, maintenance, additional resources) remains pending — the page renders the standard 'More Information Coming Soon' banner until those sections are added.
